description: Unofficial Mordecai fan art inspired by Regular Show. The blue-jay-like companion rakes a tiny leaf pile, taps a miniature keyboard, recovers from a mistimed note and takes a careful cup break. Original nine-state choreography with long-leg directional running, balancing tail feathers and five jumping phases. Simplified plumage and harmless desktop props; no official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
